label: Flux 3 Klein Edit
description: FLUX 3 Image Klein edit of one frame by a text prompt, with up to 3 reference images and 4 area boxes. Output: the edited frame at plate size.
usage: Edits one frame from a text prompt (Flux 3 Klein), with up to 3 reference images.
Pick the frame with 'frame' (Set to current frame) - only that frame is sent.
The plate is image 1, ref2-ref4 are images 2-4. Draw the area boxes in the viewer to point at regions.
refine prompt = let the enhancer rewrite the prompt first (Run enhancer only to preview it).
Press Render in ComfyUI; Bring in output reads the result under the node.

highlights: 'roll off' (default) compresses values above 1 going in: highlights return approximate, saturated colours shift, deep shadows are crushed and new near-whites come back hot. 'clip' cuts at 1 and keeps shadows open.

License (checked 2026-11): FLUX Kommunity v1.0 - commercial outputs are free under $5M annual revenue (affiliates count); above that needs a Black Forest Labs license. Outputs can't be used to improve a competing model. Fine-tuning and distribution aren't blanket-allowed.

output.tooltip: Flux works on display-referred images, so highlights are rolled off or clipped (see the highlights knob). Comp the edit back over the plate only where it changed.

knobs.name: prompt
knobs.label: prompt
knobs.tooltip: Describe the whole result with the edit folded in. The plate is <ref_image_0>, ref2-ref4 are <ref_image_1>-<ref_image_3>; box N is <obj_N>.

knobs.name: refine_prompt
knobs.label: refine prompt
knobs.tooltip: Let the Flux 3 prompt upsampler (sees the images) rewrite the prompt first. Slower, usually better.

knobs.name: megapixels
knobs.label: megapixels
knobs.tooltip: Working size of the plate and references (aspect kept). 1 = about 1 MP; more = more detail, slower. The result is scaled back to plate size.

knobs.name: highlights
knobs.label: highlights
knobs.tooltip: roll off (default): the plate and refs go in through ACES Output - sRGB and the result comes back through its inverse, so highlights are compressed instead of cut. Highlights come back approximate, saturated colours shift, deep shadows are crushed, and new near-white pixels come back hot (display 0.98 = about 7, 1.0 = about 16). clip: values above 1 reach the model as 1 (colorimetric), shadows stay open. Comp only the changed area.

knobs.name: negative_prompt
knobs.label: negative prompt
knobs.tooltip: What to avoid. Only has an effect with cfg above 1.
